## Go on. Ask.

Everything. Every command, every file, every dollar, recorded on your machine the moment it happens. Any session can be played back like a tape.

And what they made opens right beside the terminal that made it. Code with the changed lines marked. PDFs. Videos. Web pages. Your app, running.

An agent decides to delete a folder. Push to main. Run something your rules say it shouldn't.

Diana holds it, and asks you. Allow once, or deny. Everything that needs you waits in one place, and nothing else interrupts you.

Every other tool watches one agent. Diana sits above all of them. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, side by side, in one window.

It's a terminal you actually type in. A record that can't be quietly rewritten. And a place to start work that tells you what it will cost before a cent is spent.

Run five agents and still go to lunch. Race one task across three of them and keep the best. Hand over a to-do list at night with a budget, and wake up to finished work.

Plus the short list of things that really do need you. Nothing more.
